```{r message=FALSE, warning=FALSE}
## Load Packages
load.lib<-c("readxl","tidyverse","scales", "bestNormalize","agricolae","nlme","multcomp","patchwork") # List of required packages
install.lib <- load.lib[!load.lib %in% installed.packages()] # Select missing packages
for(lib in install.lib) install.packages(lib,dependencies=TRUE) # Install missing packages + dependencies
sapply(load.lib,require,character=TRUE) # Load all packages.

## Set ggplot theme
my_theme <- theme(line              = element_line(size=1.2),
                  rect              = element_rect(size=1.2),
                  text              = element_text(size=18,color="black"),
                  panel.background  = element_rect(fill="white",color="white"),
                  plot.background   = element_rect(fill = "white", color = NA),
                  panel.grid.major  = element_blank(), 
                  panel.grid.minor  = element_blank(),
                  axis.text.x       = element_text(size=18,color="black"), #,angle=90),
                  axis.text.y       = element_text(size=18,color="black"),
                  axis.title.x      = element_text(margin = margin(t = 10, r = 0, b = 0, l = 0)),
                  axis.title.y      = element_text(margin = margin(t = 0, r = 10, b = 0, l = 0)),
                  axis.ticks.x      = element_line(color="black"),
                  axis.ticks.y      = element_line(color="black"),
                  # axis.line         = element_line(color = "black", size = 0.1),
                  panel.border      = element_rect(color = "black", fill=NA, size=1.2),
                  legend.key        = element_blank(), # removes background of legend bullets
                  legend.position   = "none"
                  ) 
```

```{r}
dat <- read_excel("data/ELISA-percent-mCPG-summary.xlsx", sheet = "summary", col_names = TRUE)
dat2 <- read_excel("data/bismark-percent-mCPG-summary.xlsx", sheet = "raw", col_names = TRUE)
```


```{r}
# Generate the boxplot
# We map treatment to the x-axis, percent to the y-axis, and color by ploidy
p1 <- ggplot(dat, aes(x = treatment, y = percent, fill = ploidy)) +
  geom_boxplot(color="black", linewidth=1) +
  scale_fill_manual(values = c("diploid" = "royalblue1", 
                               "triploid" = "orangered1")) +
  labs(title = NULL, x = NULL, y = "%5-mC") +
  ylim(0.5, 5) +
  my_theme

p1

# Save the plot
ggsave(filename = "plots/methylation_boxplot.png", 
       plot = p1, 
       width = 8, 
       height = 6, 
       units = "in", 
       dpi = 1000)
```

```{r}

dat_stat <- dat
# Ensure we are using the correct column for percent
test_me <- dat_stat$percent

dat_stat$ploidy     <- factor(dat_stat$ploidy)
dat_stat$treatment  <- factor(dat_stat$treatment)

# 1. Normality Check & Manual Arcsin Transformation
norm_test <- shapiro.test(test_me)

if(norm_test$p.value < 0.05) {
    # Arcsin transformation: asin(sqrt(p))
    # We divide by 100 because asin() requires values between 0 and 1
    dat_stat$response <- asin(sqrt(test_me / 100))
    message("Data was non-normal. Applied Arcsin Square Root transformation.")
    
    # Re-check normality after transformation (optional but recommended)
    new_norm <- shapiro.test(dat_stat$response)
    message("New Shapiro p-value: ", round(new_norm$p.value, 4))
} else {
    dat_stat$response <- test_me
    message("Data is normal; no transformation applied.")
}

# 2. Interaction Model
my_test <- aov(response ~ ploidy * treatment, data = dat_stat)
my_test_summary <- summary(my_test)
print(summary(my_test))

# 3. Multiple Comparisons
# Creating the interaction group for HSD
dat_stat$group_idx <- interaction(dat_stat$treatment, dat_stat$ploidy)
amod <- aov(response ~ group_idx, data = dat_stat)

library(agricolae)
mult_comp <- HSD.test(amod, "group_idx", group=TRUE, console=TRUE)

# Display the letters for your plot
print(mult_comp$groups)

write.table(my_test_summary[[1]],                 file = "stats/AOV_5-mC.csv",      row.names = TRUE)
write.table(mult_comp$groups,                     file = "stats/HSD_test_5-mC.csv", row.names = TRUE)

```



```{r}

dat_stat <- dat2
# Using the specific column for dat2
test_me <- dat_stat$`%mCpG`

dat_stat$ploidy     <- factor(dat_stat$ploidy)
dat_stat$treatment  <- factor(dat_stat$treatment)

# 1. Normality Check & Manual Arcsin Transformation
norm_test <- shapiro.test(test_me)

if(norm_test$p.value < 0.05) {
    # Applying Arcsin Square Root transformation
    # Formula: asin(sqrt(p)) where p is a proportion (0-1)
    dat_stat$response <- asin(sqrt(test_me / 100))
    message("Data was non-normal. Applied Arcsin Square Root transformation.")
    
    # Optional: Check if normality improved
    new_norm <- shapiro.test(dat_stat$response)
    message("Post-transformation Shapiro p-value: ", round(new_norm$p.value, 4))
} else {
    dat_stat$response <- test_me
    message("Data is normal; no transformation applied.")
}

# 2. Interaction Model
# Testing main effects and the interaction between ploidy and treatment
my_test <- aov(response ~ ploidy * treatment, data = dat_stat)
my_test_summary <- summary(my_test)

# 3. Multiple Comparisons (HSD Test)
# Create the combined factor for comparing all group combinations
dat_stat$group_idx <- interaction(dat_stat$treatment, dat_stat$ploidy)
amod <- aov(response ~ group_idx, data = dat_stat)

library(agricolae)
mult_comp <- HSD.test(amod, "group_idx", group=TRUE, console=TRUE)

# Display the letters for your plot
print(mult_comp$groups)

write.table(my_test_summary[[1]],                 file = "stats/AOV_%mCpG.csv",      row.names = TRUE)
write.table(mult_comp$groups,                     file = "stats/HSD_%mCpG.csv", row.names = TRUE)
```



```{r}
# Load patchwork (install if needed: install.packages("patchwork"))
library(patchwork)

# Ensure p1 and p2 are defined as you have them above
# (Note: I've removed the title from p2 for a cleaner combined look)

p3 <- p1 + p2 + 
  plot_layout(guides = "collect") # Combines the legend into one
  # plot_annotation(tag_levels = 'A') # Adds "A" and "B" labels to the plots

# View the combined plot
p3

# Save the combined side-by-side plot
ggsave(filename = "plots/methylation_combined_facet.png", 
       plot = p3, 
       width = 10, # Increased width for side-by-side
       height = 7, 
       units = "in", 
       dpi = 600)
```
